mapper.select: SELECT p.POST_ID as postId, p.WS_ID as wsId, p.TITLE as title, p.CONTENT as content, p.USER_ID as userId, u.USER_NAME as writerName, p.VIEW_COUNT as viewCount, p.BOARD_TYPE as boardType, p.IS_PINNED as isPinned, TO_CHAR(p.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as regDt FROM BOARD_POSTS p JOIN USERS u ON p.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE p.POST_ID = #{postId}

SELECT R.REPLY_ID, R.CONTENT, R.USER_ID, TO_CHAR(R.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS REG_DT, U.USER_NAME FROM BOARD_REPLIES R JOIN USERS U ON R.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE R.POST_ID = #{postId} ORDER BY R.REG_DT ASC
